briefing.headline: Anthropic and xAI escalate multi-agent benchmarks as compute shortages intensify

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race remains intense with frontier labs releasing incremental advances in reasoning and agentic systems. Funding continues at record pace while regulatory scrutiny grows. Prompt injection vulnerabilities persist across deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus with enhanced multi-agent orchestration. xAI's Grok-3 achieved new scores on agent collaboration benchmarks. DeepSeek open-sourced a 70B reasoning model.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft announced a new 100k H100 cluster in Texas. TSMC reports sustained demand for next-gen AI accelerators through 2027.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems reach autonomous scientific discovery before 2028?
